arguments.command:
python -c "
from semver import VersionInfo

v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)

# Check with ==
print('v == \"1.2.3\":', v == '1.2.3')

# Check with __eq__
print('v.__eq__(\"1.2.3\"):', v.__eq__('1.2.3'))

# Check with !=
print('v != \"1.2.3\":', v != '1.2.3')
"
